goals: Route acquired items into supported unlocked carried shulkers using exact physical matching contents or matching empty CSR reservations, preserving component identity, effective capacities, counts, and existing global destination order.
Preserve established passive-pickup, external QUICK_MOVE, and player-origin QUICK_MOVE behavior across vanilla and Inventory Extended storage while composing safely with Offhand Shift-Click QoL.
Provide a server-authoritative lock control that excludes selected carriers from automatic routing without altering their other contents or components.
scope: Canonical C16 / 0.3.11-transparent-lock-sprites-canary1 for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric, implementation checkpoint 9c5ea267f49812385b981a5ab04b73061b029974; transparent-art and one-pixel vertical-offset successor to C15 paired with unchanged CSR C16.

When a server-resolved routing-lock target is unsupported, return without an overlay message. Preserve server-authoritative supported-target toggles and their existing Locked/Unlocked feedback exactly.

Passive ground pickup and external-container QUICK_MOVE priority through component-identical occupied main hand, qualifying carried containers, occupied hotbar, occupied offhand, compatible ordinary-storage partials, empty hotbar, and empty ordinary storage.
Player-origin QUICK_MOVE routing to a component-identical occupied offhand and qualifying carried containers before returning exact remainder ownership to the active menu's normal algorithm.
Creative and Survival inventory snapshot alignment, source cleanup and menu callbacks, exact remainder accounting, stable carrier order, and persistent per-carrier auto-routing lock state.

Only the shared ShulkerDestination changes routing admission: physical component-exact matches seed affinity unless their reservation conflicts; full matching physical stacks retain affinity. Physically empty RESERVED_MATCH slots also seed affinity. Empty unreserved, unrelated, locked, and nesting-prohibited destinations remain ineligible.

Read only ContainerSlotReservationsApi.classify(ItemStack,int,ItemStack), isReserved(ItemStack,int), reservationMatches(ItemStack,int,ItemStack), and the client-only ShulkerPanelHeaderDecorations API after FabricLoader confirms CSR is loaded. CSR remains suggests *: direct header API linkage is isolated in a reflection-loaded client bridge, absent/incompatible linkage leaves CCAR fully functional without a badge.

Build one immutable slot/count plan before mutation: compatible occupied stacks in physical order, all matching reserved empties in physical order, then unreserved empties in physical order. Rewrite CONTAINER once and shrink the incoming stack by exactly the accepted total; retain reservations, lock, name, lore, damage, and unrelated components.

Keep accepted bundle class bytes unchanged, global destination and carrier order unchanged, all existing pickup/QUICK_MOVE contexts, offhand/excluded-source behavior, and Stacks Are Stacks effective maximums without a new stack-size implementation.

When optional CSR is present, expose the existing RoutingLock state for supported shulkers only as a non-clickable 1:1 supplied lock sprite in CSR's header. Bundles remain tooltip-only. C16 derives its direct resources from C15's immutable supplied locked.png (7x9, 155 bytes, SHA-256 cde847dba65a29823d62fee4f70fc4c1e83fd40e4fbbc4b81871b9164f11e617, opaque RGBA) and unlocked.png (10x9, 590 bytes, SHA-256 10a5f3205c311974eea2798e1c97cca248798f12b7156c202c59afbb850fc39c, opaque RGBA): only exact opaque #FFFFFFFF pixels become #00000000, producing locked SHA-256 bbe0d7393b626c1bc2d6b7d9f938888d4a99ae130eb90ecd2cb5711a909e226d and unlocked SHA-256 a87026fa1ab3a82cf76cd0dd5a68cf79fa49ef2e0fbfed27964ad18c7d48c656. Direct package integrity checks prove the 29 non-white opaque pixels and all dimensions remain exact; no crop or generated-art pipeline remains.

exclusions: Equipment, Trinkets, trash, and foreign menu slots remain excluded.
No generic automatic backpack: an empty unreserved shulker or a nonmatching reservation cannot establish affinity; locked carriers and forbidden nesting remain denied.
No internal CSR persistence access, reservation mutation, fake stacks, runtime CSR pin, foreign classes, or nested CSR/upstream JAR.
No modifications to bundles, global destination/carrier order, accepted C11/rollback C10 bytes, QSN C8, SAS C2, Easy Shulker Boxes, Item Interactions, or other project implementations.
No successor runtime pass/promotion inferred from controlled tests; no dedicated Minecraft launch or protected gameplay-profile access.
